articles.title: Philosopher's Stone
articles.summary: Dark purple-black with a fine gem-like grid and scattered violet sparkle, satin with subtle glow. Reads as a dark murky purple-magenta car with a grainy speckle; colours wash into a muted violet, nothing bold stands out.
articles.what: The impossible packing: discs of every size nested into the gaps of the discs before them, each cut as a gem. A FRACTURED RELICS finish. Up close: Micro-fine field of tiny pinwheel and flower-like discs, 8-15 px across, drawn in dark charcoal lines packed together, with purple, magenta and a few brick-red patches filling the gaps in blocky clumps. Very dense and noisy, with no clear large shapes. From a distance: Reads as a dark murky purple-magenta car with a grainy speckle; colours wash into a muted violet, nothing bold stands out. Measured spec (average): metal 149, roughness 95, coat 151. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.
